'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Kankara kidnapping]]
***[[Katsina State|Katsina]]'s governor [[Aminu Bello Masari]] says 344 pupils [[kidnap]]ped from a [[boarding school]] in [[Kankara]] by [[Boko Haram]] on December 11 have been freed in [[Zamfara State|Zamfara]]. [https://aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/17/hundreds-of-nigerian-schoolboys-released-local-governor-says (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**Two [[roadside bombing]]s near [[Sheikh Zuweid]] in [[Egypt]]'s [[Sinai Peninsula]], kill three [[Egyptian Army]] [[troop]]s and wound 10 others. Separately, [[Egyptian military]] raids on Sheikh Zuweid kill four [[Islamist]] [[militant]]s. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/egypt-officials-bombs-kill-security-forces-sinai-74796207 (ABC News)]
*[[Terrorism in Australia]]
**A knifeman kills two elderly people after storming their home and then tries to attack police officers on a highway in [[Brisbane]], [[Australia]]. The attacker, who is shot dead by police, has been identified as a 22-year-old man inspired by the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]]. He was arrested in early 2019 when he tried to join the group in [[Somalia]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/australia-brisbane-couple-death-terrorism-suspect-shot-police-13797700 (CNA)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage Lists]]
**[[government of Malaysia|Malaysia]]n [[Minister of Tourism, Arts and Culture (Malaysia)|Minister of Tourism, Arts and Culture]] [[Nancy Shukri]] announces that the [[UNESCO]] [[Intergovernmental organization|Intergovernmental]] Committee [[Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage|for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage]] has listed [[pantun]] and wangkang on the [[UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage Lists]]. This marks the first time that [[Malaysia]] has gained UNESCO recognition along with other countries, as the pantun was jointly nominated with [[Indonesia]] and the wangkang ceremony was jointly nominated with [[China]]. [https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2020/12/650345/pantun-wangkang-ceremony-recognised-unesco-intangible-cultural-heritage (NST)]
**The [[Finnish sauna]] culture is inscribed on the UNESCO list. As authorized by [[Finland|the state]], the [[Finnish Heritage Agency]] commits, together with Finnish sauna communities and promoters of the sauna culture, to safeguard the vitality of the sauna tradition and to highlight its importance as part of customs and wellbeing. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/finnish_sauna_culture_steams_up_unesco_heritage_list/11703917 (YLE)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020–21 South Pacific cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Yasa]] makes landfall in [[Bua Province]], [[Fiji]], at around 6:00 a.m. UTC (6:00 p.m. [[Time in Fiji|FJT]]), two hours ahead of its forecasted schedule. [https://www.fbcnews.com.fj/news/tc-yasa/tc-yasa-makes-landfall-ahead-of-schedule/ (FBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Ireland]]
*****The [[Northern Ireland Executive]] agrees to impose a new lockdown beginning on [[Boxing Day]], which means that non-essential shops will be closed from the end of trading on [[Christmas Eve]]. During the first week of lockdown, essential shops will have to close each day at 8:00 p.m. [[Greenwich Mean Time|GMT]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-55349545 (BBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] tests positive for COVID-19. [[Prime Minister of Spain|Spanish Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]], [[Prime Minister of Portugal|Portuguese Prime Minister]] [[António Costa]], Secretary-General of the [[OECD]] [[José Ángel Gurría]] and President of the [[European Council]] [[Charles Michel]] self-isolate after having contact with Macron earlier this week. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55347406 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****The [[Robert Koch Institute]] reports a revised total of more than 30,000 cases in the past 24 hours, a new record, because around 3,500 cases in [[Baden-Württemberg]] were not initially reported. [https://www.thelocal.de/20201217/germany-sees-record-daily-virus-infections-of-over-30000-official (The Local Germany)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands]] reports a new single-day record of 12,844 cases, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 652,525. [https://nltimes.nl/2020/12/17/13000-new-coronavirus-infections-covid-hospital-total-tops-2000 (NL Times)]
****[[Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport|Dutch Health Minister]] [[Hugo de Jonge]] says that [[vaccination]]s using the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine will begin on January 8 if the [[European Medicines Agency]] approves it for use next week. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/netherlands-aims-begin-pfizer-biontech-shots-jan-74782834 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Ministry of Health (Poland)|Health Minister]] [[Adam Niedzielski]] announces a nationwide [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] that will close hotels and [[ski slope]]s from December 28 to January 17. He also says that a [[curfew]] will be imposed on [[New Year's Eve]] from 7:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. local time. [https://polandin.com/51376485/poland-imposes-national-quarantine (Poland In)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Prime Minister of Portugal|Prime Minister]] António Costa says that an overnight [[curfew]] beginning at 11:00 p.m. will be in effect in the [[Portugal|country]] on [[New Year's Eve]]. He also added that people would not be allowed to leave their homes between 1:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. from January 1 to 3. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/portugal-imposes-overnight-curfew-on-new-year-eve-covid-19-13796356 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in San Marino]]
****The Government imposes a curfew between 00:30 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. from 18 December. [https://www.sanmarinortv.sm/news/politica-c2/coprifuoco-notturno-e-cenone-al-ristorante-le-misure-per-le-festivita-nel-nuovo-decreto-a198646 (San Marino TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 243 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 17,364. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-reports-27515-more-coronavirus-infections/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****Mayor [[Hennadiy Kernes]] of [[Kharkiv]], Ukraine's second largest city, dies in Germany due to complications caused by [[COVID-19]] after contracting the virus in September. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/kharkiv-mayor-kernes-dies-from-covid-19-complications.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Jakarta]] [[Governor of Jakarta|Governor]] [[Anies Baswedan]] issues a gubernatorial instruction and decree that requires anyone leaving and entering the city from tomorrow until January 8 to have a negative rapid antigen test result. The order also limits the capacity of offices to 50% and requires cafés, restaurants and tourist attractions to close at 7:00 p.m. local time from December 24 to 27 and December 31 to January 2. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/paper/2020/12/17/jakarta-tightens-restrictions-ahead-of-holidays.html. (''The Jakarta Post'')] [https://jakartaglobe.id/news/entering-and-leaving-jakarta-requires-rapid-antigen-test (Jakarta Globe)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****The [[Tokyo Metropolitan Government]] raises its healthcare alert level to the top level for the first time as the number of infections continues to increase. This comes as [[Tokyo]] reports a record of 822 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/tokyo-says-covid-19-strain-on-hospitals-severe-raises-alert-to-highest (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Palestine]]
****The [[Palestinian Authority]] impose a two-week lockdown in the entire [[West Bank]] that orders schools, universities, restaurants, barbershops, gyms and leisure venues to close. As part of the lockdown, the curfew has also been extended for two weeks. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/pa-announces-two-week-closure-throughout-west-bank-as-virus-surges/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]]
****[[Saudi Arabia]] begins its [[vaccination]] campaign a day after it received two shipments of the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[Tozinameran|vaccine]]. More than 150,000 people have registered to receive the vaccine. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/17/saudi-arabia-kicks-off-coronavirus-vaccination-campaign (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 22 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 634. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201217001951320?section=national/national (Yonhap News Agency)]

*****[[California]] reports 52,281 new cases and 379 deaths in the past 24 hours, both a new single-day record for the state and nationwide since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://abc7news.com/coronavirus-deaths-california-new-cases-covid-19-pandemic/8851283/ (KABC-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
*****[[Texas]] reports a new single-day record of 16,864 cases, bringing the totals to 1,371,223 confirmed cases and 167,966 probable cases. [https://cbsaustin.com/news/local/all-time-high-number-of-new-cases-in-texas (KEYE-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
*****[[Cedric Richmond]], advisor to [[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]], tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/biden-adviser-cedric-richmond-tests-positive-for-covid-19/ (CBS News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Alberta]] reports a record 30 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the provincial death toll to 790. [https://calgaryherald.com/news/local-news/dr-deena-hinshaw-to-provide-albertas-covid-19-update-at-330-p-m (''Calgary Herald'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports 2,432 cases, a new-single day record. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/article-ontario-hospitals-call-for-new-and-stricter-covid-19-lockdowns-in-hard/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Legality of euthanasia]]
**The Spanish [[Congress of Deputies]] approves the decriminalisation of [[euthanasia]], becoming the sixth country to do so. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20201217/6129948/congreso-aprueba-ley-eutanasia.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
**The Chilean [[Chamber of Deputies of Chile|Chamber of Deputies]] approves a bill to allow euthanasia. [https://www.t13.cl/noticia/politica/diputados-eutanasia-chile-muerte-digna-17-12-20 (''La Tercera'')]
*[[Adass Israel School sex abuse scandal]]
**[[Israel]]i [[Ministry of Justice (Israel)|Justice Minister]] [[Avi Nissenkorn]] signs an [[extradition]] order to [[Australia]] for accused [[child sex abuse]]r Malka Leifer, after she was [[convicted]] of faking [[mental illness]] to avoid extradition earlier this year. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/16/israeli-minister-orders-extradition-of-malka-leifer-to-australia (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Human rights in Australia]]
**An ombudsman report finds that the [[Victoria (Australia)|Victorian]] state [[Victoria State Government|government]]'s decision to briefly impose a "hard lockdown" on public housing towers in July in response to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], not allowing anyone in or out, was a violation of [[human rights]]. The state government refuses to apologise to the tower residents despite the report's recommendations. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/dec/17/melbourne-public-housing-covid-lockdown-violated-human-rights-victorias-ombudsman-finds (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Modern display of the Confederate battle flag]]
**[[Governor of New York|New York Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] signs into law a bill banning the display and sale of [[Flags of the Confederate States of America#Battle flag|Confederate battle flags]], [[Swastika#Use_in_Nazism_(1920–1945)|Nazi swastikas]] and other 'symbols of hate' on [[New York (state)|state]]-owned property. Cuomo has promised to address concerns that this law could violate freedom of speech. [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/new-ny-law-bans-sale-of-confederate-flags-on-state-property/2784790/ (WNBC-TV)]
*[[Jean-Luc Brunel]], an associate of [[Jeffrey Epstein]], is arrested in [[France]] on charges of [[rape]] and [[sex trafficking]]. [https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/ny-jeffrey-epstein-brunel-rape-arrest-20201217-xnkpw7dxv5hn3cz6u42bmjiv7m-story.html?outputType=amp (''The New York Daily News'')]
